title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Schedule: Billing-Time Fraction on a Duplicate Foreign Posting
content:
**Schedule rule.** For a notice that a purchase processed in a foreign currency or outside the United States posted twice to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the billing-time fraction follows the posting in error's own posting date, from which the erroneous charge was on the balance: when the posting in error belongs to the latest billing period, the fraction is the calendar days from its posting date to the latest statement date divided by 30; when its posting date is after the latest statement date, the fraction is zero; otherwise it is one.

The latest billing period is the billing period of the account's most recent statement; the posting in error's billing period and posting date are read from its transaction record.

## Schedule

| Posting in error | Billing-time fraction |
|---|---|
| belongs to the latest billing period | its days to the latest statement date, divided by 30 |
| posted after the latest statement date | zero |
| belongs to an earlier billing period | one |

## Worked fractions (hypothetical latest statement dated 30 June)

| Posting in error posted | Billing period | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 18 June | the latest (June) | 12 divided by 30: 0.4 |
| 30 June | the latest (June) | zero days: 0 |
| 3 July | after the latest statement date | 0 |
| 20 May | an earlier period (May) | 1 |
